Doors into this life

If you already know what you are looking for, begin here. Everything below sets out the same life in fuller form.

Learn Teaching, catechesis and formation, for anyone who wants to understand the faith better. Serve Practical ways to help around the parish, however much time you have to give. Connect Coffee hour in the parish hall after the Liturgy, and the ordinary company of one another. Care Offer help to a household that needs it — or ask for help yourself. Celebrate Feast days, Holy Week and Pascha, and the year the parish keeps together. Share Pass on something you know how to do — a food, a craft, a hymn, a tradition.
